authorship_boundary: Astra authored the A237 route set and the two-stage debit. This review does not accept LAB927, does not accept the whole Node, and does not treat the author result as evidence of execution.

findings.fact: A Python None member is both a NULL slot and a stored Py_None. The preview keeps every non-Windows OSError_str route consistent with that reading. It does not pick one pointer state.

The pinned OSError_str reads filename2 only after a non-NULL filename. A proven filename2 suppresses the one-filename candidate. A NULL filename still reaches the stem or the BaseException args fallback, so the ignored filename2 is not required.

When filename reads as None and errno or strerror also reads as None, the candidate set adds BaseException_str: empty string, one PyObject_Str, or the tuple repr. Stored-None errno and deleted errno share one candidate set. str selects the real route afterward.

The returned message is the complete str result. No candidate replaces it. The 900-code-point domain is applied to the minimum, so a longer legal route does not refuse a shorter one. 900 stays in domain while 906 and 914 stay uncharged. 901 fails before debit and before str.

project_owned_error passes reserve_lower_bound. The first call adds the minimum. The second adds actual minus minimum. Their sum is the actual length. The ledger is additive. It is not the maximum, not a reset, and not a refund. GRAPH_CHARGED still receives only the later canonical JSON length.

Prefix rendering calls the same full_stock_message without a debit callback, then encodes the complete message. The snapshot keeps or overflows a whole blob. Both v2 readers are outside the changed hunks and match the baseline after binding normalization.

A domain failure, a membership failure, or a completion-debit failure is retained with its traceback and re-raised. A later call does not format again. The graph object is built only after every message returns.

Bytes, non-ASCII, a changed slot, a non-OSError, and any piece without a stock length return no preview. full_stock_message then uses the original str path. Those factories stay enabled. Their prospective admission is not proven.

Visible workspace is the maximum of the exact route formulas and is compared only with the existing per-file address-space cap. In-domain alternatives in the 16 vectors stay far below that cap. This is not allocator, RSS, CPU, header, or shared-pool admission. Integer conversion cost stays unqualified.

Long-integer conversion buffer, bytes filename repr, non-ASCII printability, custom slots, and other factories remain on the residual path or unqualified.
